author: Copilot
body: `/account/contact` no longer enforces any permission check (and it now uses `tenant_context` directly). This is a behavioral/security change: users without the intended permission can call the endpoint, and API-key tokens are no longer blocked (that restriction currently lives in `require_permission`). Consider reintroducing an authorization dependency (or a dedicated dependency that at least denies API keys) to prevent abuse/spam of the Slack notification path.

author: Copilot
body: `service_name` is stripped in a `@field_validator`, but the `Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=100)` constraints are applied before that validator by default in Pydantic v2. That means leading/trailing whitespace counts toward the length checks (e.g., a value that is >100 chars only due to surrounding spaces will be rejected). If you want constraints to apply to the trimmed value, strip in a `mode='before'` validator or use `StringConstraints(strip_whitespace=True, ...)`/equivalent so trimming happens prior to length validation.

body:
The docstring says this returns a "locale-formatted" TB string, but the implementation hard-codes `'en-US'`. Either update the comment to reflect the fixed locale, or use the runtime locale (e.g., `toLocaleString()` without specifying `'en-US'`) if the intent is truly locale-aware formatting.
```suggestion
/** Formats a numeric value as an en-US-formatted TB string (e.g. 1,234 TB). */
```
